Verification: `uv run ruff check .` → all checks passed. `uv run mypy src` → success, no issues in 148 source files. `uv run pytest -q` → 298 passed, 40 xfailed, 0 failed (needs_docker/needs_model/needs_gpu/needs_network tiers excluded by default addopts, as designed). Pytest was run twice: first run surfaced the one pre-existing test now made stale by the new deps (test_minimal_runtime_dependencies), fixed it, second run was clean.

Only 3 files touched (within budget): pyproject.toml, uv.lock (uv-managed, not hand-edited), tests/unit/test_tooling_config.py. No commits made (git status shows 3 modified, unstaged files). No emojis. Did not read any docs beyond the specified bible sec. 6.7/7.1 (grepped then offset-read) and the 3 files edited/verified.

issues: The contract makes `Figure.artifact` required, but §3.1 says to omit `figure.artifact` when an image exceeds `max_bindata_bytes`. Both cannot hold. The adapter currently drops the figure block, sets quality=degraded and records it in vendor_json. Needs a contract or doc decision.

The source-bytes port `ctx.source_bytes()` is not in the sdk `StageContext` protocol (proposal in 04 open issue 18). `run()` looks it up with getattr and raises `parse.conversion_failed` if it is missing.

`repeatHeader="1"` is the Hancom default (24 of 24 tables), so under the spec rule almost every multi-row table gets header row 0 with `header_inferred=false`. Needs a decision on whether to treat it as inferred instead.
`opf:title` is junk in 공문 templates ("3", "□ 포럼개요") yet becomes `metadata.title`, the fallback title source. Needs a trust policy.

Genre and table-role heuristics misfire on the press releases. All three are classified genre=form because their 1×3 banner tables satisfy n_form_tbl≥1 and n_body≤20, and the 1×3 banner tables themselves get role=form. The TOC rule was tightened beyond the spec (it now requires dot leaders or a page-number column), so §3.6 needs updating and golden-set tuning.

Not implemented in the spike: promoting adjacent "<표 N>" or "그림 N" paragraphs to captions; the header_kind=row rule; TOC-style blocks; memo anchors (memos are attached to the preceding block at offset 0); fields inside table cells (only counted); footnotes in cells use the cell start as offset; the figure_ocr, formula_latex and page_map_render options; checks on real dutmal/compose content.
Merged caption blocks use the `element_path` `.../hp:caption[0]`. The §3.3 grammar only defines caption paragraph paths, so this needs confirming.

Text boxes (rect/drawText) and shape groups (hp:container) are implemented but not covered by any sample. A Hancom-saved sample with text boxes, tracked changes, memos, hyperlinks and encryption is needed.
Encryption detection uses the ODF convention element `encryption-data`, which is an assumption. It is unverified because no encrypted HWPX sample was available.
`config_hash` is approximated with `json.dumps(sort_keys)` because the sdk has no `canonical_json`. `PLUGIN_VERSION` is hard-coded to 0.1.0.
'ㅇ' (Hangul jamo) is common as a bullet in 공문 but is not in the §3.4/§3.5 marker set.

Server-mode checks not run (needs_docker): payload index effects (is_tenant subgraph, prefix index size and latency, #65), per-query IDF performance, payload-only points and insert-only behaviour on the server, server vector-size limit, server RRF rank base. The one-time Windows qdrant.exe v1.19.1 run was blocked by the permission policy on running external binaries.
RRF rank base: local Qdrant scores 1/(k+rank0). If platform fuser.rrf ranks from 1 (bible §8.1), the equivalent server request is k=61; confirm with fuser_equivalence before enabling server fusion.

filters.py copies the doc 13 §4.3 example for the ACL condition: acl_visibility IN visible_set OR acl_allow match. If visible_set can include 'restricted', restricted records would pass without an acl_allow entry; the policy owner (bible §10.2) should confirm.
QdrantIndexBackend does not implement the sdk.ports.IndexBackend Protocol (tenant-only search signature with no ACL); aligning the port with the doc 13 §2.1 signatures is open issue 1 in doc 13.
The bm25s top-k rank match (ADR-0012 compliance check (b)) needs a MIRACL-ko sample; deferred to tier 2.
Existing code in adapters/embed/tei_dense.py and vllm_pooling_bge_m3.py fails ruff EM101 (outside this task's scope).
Kiwi analyzer_id is recorded as 'kiwi:0.23.2:default'; the bible §6.1 example is 'kiwi:0.24.0:cong'. The dictionary/model label should be settled under ADR-0021.
The docs/12-appendix/09 deferred-verification ledger has not been regenerated to include the new DEFERRED comments (tools/verify/gen-deferred-ledger.mjs).

docs/04-pipelines/12-embedding.md의 '확인 필요' 7곳(vLLM truncate_prompt_tokens 파라미터명, /pooling 응답 스키마·--io-processor-plugin 인터페이스, XLM-R 특수 토큰 id·vocab_size=250002, vLLM/TEI 이미지 태그, 처리량·지연 실측치, KURE-v2 token_embed 서빙 가능성)는 모두 실 서버·실 모델·실측이 필요해 이번 스파이크에서 미확정 상태로 남았다 — needs_docker/needs_gpu/needs_model 환경에서 후속 검증 필요.
vllm_pooling_bge_m3.py의 /pooling 요청·응답 스키마는 코드가 가정한 제안 형태(예: {"input":[...]} -> [{"dense":[...],"sparse":{...}}])이며 실 vLLM 0.29 --runner pooling 서버로 계약 테스트 코퍼스(카세트) 검증 전까지 골격이다.
